title: How does SOS for 60+ work?
body:
How does SOS for 60+ work?

SOS for people 60+ is the red button in the simple interface.

What happens:
• You press SOS
• Family and emergency contacts get an alert
• You can quickly ask for help

⚠️ This is not medical care and not a substitute for 112!

✅ ALADDIN helps your family know you need help.
